title: Vocabulary Quiz — Unit 11A: Present perfect and irregular past participles
subtitle: Irregular past participles, ever / never and film words

words.vi: bị vỡ, bị hỏng (quá khứ phân từ của break)
words.def: the past participle of break: not in one piece or not working
words.sent: Oh no! I have ___ my phone.

words.vi: bắt được, bị (quá khứ phân từ của catch)
words.def: the past participle of catch: to get something that is moving, or to get an illness
words.sent: I’ve ___ a cold, so I can’t go out.

words.vi: viết (quá khứ phân từ của write)
words.def: the past participle of write: to put words on paper or a screen
words.sent: She has ___ three books about her life.

words.vi: ăn (quá khứ phân từ của eat)
words.def: the past participle of eat: to put food in your mouth and swallow it
words.sent: Have you ever ___ octopus?

words.vi: mua (quá khứ phân từ của buy)
words.def: the past participle of buy: to get something when you give money for it
words.sent: He has ___ a new flat in the city centre.

words.vi: nghe thấy (quá khứ phân từ của hear)
words.def: the past participle of hear: to know a sound with your ears
words.sent: I’ve never ___ of that band.

words.vi: bay (quá khứ phân từ của fly)
words.def: the past participle of fly: to travel in a plane or through the air
words.sent: Have you ever ___ in a helicopter?

words.vi: quên (quá khứ phân từ của forget)
words.def: the past participle of forget: not remembering something
words.sent: Oh, sorry! I’ve ___ your name.

words.vi: ngã, rơi (quá khứ phân từ của fall)
words.def: the past participle of fall: to go down quickly to the ground by accident
words.sent: She has ___ down the stairs and hurt her leg.

words.vi: trồng, lớn lên (quá khứ phân từ của grow)
words.def: the past participle of grow: to put a plant in the ground and look after it
words.sent: Have you ever ___ vegetables in your garden?

words.vi: xem, nhìn thấy (quá khứ phân từ của see)
words.def: the past participle of see: to look at something with your eyes
words.sent: I’ve ___ that film four times. I love it!

words.vi: đã từng đến (quá khứ phân từ của be)
words.def: the past participle of be: to have gone to a place and come back
words.sent: I haven’t ___ to the USA, but I’d like to go.

words.vi: có, đã ăn/uống (quá khứ phân từ của have)
words.def: the past participle of have: to eat, drink or own something
words.sent: I haven’t ___ any coffee today.

words.vi: bao giờ, từng
words.def: at any time in your life
words.sent: Have you ___ met a famous person?
words.coll: the best film I have ___ seen

words.vi: chưa bao giờ
words.def: at no time in your life
words.sent: I’ve ___ seen a film with Rose Byrne.

words.vi: đạo diễn
words.def: the person who tells the actors what to do in a film
words.sent: Sofia Coppola is a famous film ___.

words.vi: diễn viên
words.def: a person whose job is to play a part in a film or a play
words.sent: Margot Robbie is a very popular ___.

words.vi: giải thưởng
words.def: a prize that you win for doing something very well
words.sent: She has won an ___ for her new film.

words.vi: phim truyền hình dài tập
words.def: a TV programme with many parts that tells the story of people’s lives
words.sent: Mia has acted in two ___ on TV.

words.vi: chung (have something in common)
words.def: shared with other people
words.sent: The three actors have a lot in ___.
